{{Quote|Look at the ''size'' of that thing.|[[Boomer (Advanced Recon Force trooper)|CS-2207]]|audio=BoomerLooksTriDroid.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]''</ref>}}
The '''octuptarra magna tri-droid''', also simply known as the '''tri-droid''', was an extremely sized-up version of the [[Octuptarra combat tri-droid/Legends|octuptarra combat tri-droid]] used by the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:TriDroidScale-SWCTP.png|thumb|left|250px|A tri-droid, shown with a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] for scale]]
The tri-droid was an up-scaled version of the smaller [[Octuptarra combat tri-droid/Legends|octuptarra combat tri-droid]]. The [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] developed the combat version first, re-using the design later for the much larger heavy artillery version of an infantry [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]].

Chain-fed ordnance launchers replaced the [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] of its predecessors, with the reserves of ammunition stored within the hollows of its bulbous head, although some models did retain laser cannons as seen in the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]]. One rocket fired from a single behemoth was powerful enough to annihilate a [[Unstable Terrain Artillery Transport/Legends|UT-AT]] if aimed correctly, as seen in the [[Battle of Mygeeto]]. These three-legged artillery [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were formidable in battle, reducing infantry and tanks to rubble. Their rotating multi-jointed assemblies allowed them to change facing almost instantly and they could fire from extended ranges. It was almost impossible to approach such droids, as all sides conceivably faced the front. The droid was also capable of hanging onto vertical surfaces, as seen during the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]].<ref name="The Hidden Enemy">{{TCW|The Hidden Enemy}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:Tri-droid-TCW.png|thumb|250px|A tri-droid used during the Battle of Christophsis.]]
On the planet [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]], many tri-droids saw action under the command of [[Whorm Loathsom/Legends|Whorm Loathsom]] alongside [[NR-N99 Persuader-class droid enforcer/Legends|tank droids]] and [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AATs]], covered in blue markings of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

Prior to the battle, [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] used one of the droids to escape from Generals [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. The droid was destroyed when it crashed to the ground from the building it was clung to, thanks to the two Jedi severing its limbs.

Near the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], during the Battle of Mygeeto, tri-droids were used against [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi's]] [[Galactic Marines/Legends|Galactic Marines]], decimating front lines.

Following the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|execution]] of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious's]] new [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], Darth Vader, these [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were de-activated.

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Databank (original)|Databank]] gives the height of the tri-droid as 3.7 meters, which is incorrect, as all visual sources portray it as many times larger than a [[Human/Legends|Human]], and even the same Databank entry describes it as "gigantic" compared to the 3.6 meter octuptarra droid. The decoded episode of "[[The Hidden Enemy]]" was the first source that gave tri-droid's height as 50 feet tall.
